title: IGN Entertainment 将在 Gamescom 举办 Women In Gaming 行业交流活动
content:
IGN Entertainment brings Women In Gaming networking event to Gamescom | GamesIndustry.biz

.
IGN Entertainment is hosting a Women in Gaming networking breakfast at Gamescom, on the morning of Wednesday 26th August. The event is supported by
GamesIndustry.biz
, and will take place in the Dorint Hotel am Heumarkt Köln from 8.30-10.30.
Attendees will receive a short curated Gaming Trends presentation and connect with women and allies across the industry over breakfast, giving and opportunity to build relationships that carry through the rest of gamescom week and beyond. Tickets are free, but limited and can be
requested here
.
The event follows successful WIG events during IGN Live in Los Angeles in June, and in London in April in partnership with media agency Dentsu. Those events featured dedicated presentations and panels featuring female leaders from across the industry, including Xbox, EA, CD Projekt Red, Sony and IO Interactive; topics included insights and perspectives on creating successful brand partnerships as well as career longevity for women in leadership.
